info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Banking Operational Services Disbursement By Disbursement Id-v5-spec
info.description: This API enables users to retrieve detailed information regarding specific disbursements within the banking operational services framework. By providing a unique disbursement ID, consumers can access vital data related to funds disbursed, transaction timestamps, and associated account details. Typical users include financial institutions, developers integrating banking services, and business analysts seeking insights into disbursement history. This endpoint is fundamental for ensuring transparency and accountability in financial transactions.

get.description: Fetch the details for the disbursement identified by RES-100045. This endpoint provides all relevant information associated with the specified disbursement, allowing users to view its status, amount, and any related metadata.

requestBody.description: This request body is structured for the disbursement operation for resource ID RES-100045. It must contain the specific parameters expected for looking up or processing the disbursement details.

200.description: The request was completed successfully, returning the requested disbursement details.
